test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Western Coastal Plains are narrower and lie between which features?

options.text: Eastern Ghats and Bay of Bengal

solution:
The correct answer is __**Western Ghats and Arabian Sea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Western Coastal Plains of India are situated between the **Western Ghats** and the **Arabian Sea**.
 
• They are **narrower** compared to the Eastern Coastal Plains, with an average width ranging from 50 to 100 km.
 
• The plains extend from **Gujarat in the north** to **Kerala in the south**, covering the states of Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka in between.
 
• These plains are divided into three distinct sections: the **Konkan Coast** (Maharashtra and Goa), the **Kanara Coast** (Karnataka), and the **Malabar Coast** (Kerala).
 
• The region is known for its **fertile soil, lagoons, backwaters, and estuaries**, which support agriculture, fishing, and tourism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Western Ghats:**

 
 
• A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the eight "hottest hotspots" of biological diversity globally.
 
• It is a continuous mountain range running parallel to the western coast of India.
 
• The Western Ghats play a crucial role in influencing the monsoon climate in India.
 
 
 
• **Arabian Sea:**
 
 
• Part of the northern Indian Ocean, bounded by India to the east, Pakistan and Iran to the north, and the Arabian Peninsula to the west.
 
• It is a major route for maritime trade and has significant economic importance.
 
 
 
• **Backwaters of Kerala:**
 
 
• A network of interconnected lakes, rivers, and canals along the Malabar Coast.
 
• Famous for houseboat tourism and traditional fishing practices.
 
 
 
• **Economic Significance:**
 
 
• The Western Coastal Plains are important for agriculture, with crops like rice and coconut grown extensively.
 
• Fishing is a major occupation along the coast due to the proximity to the Arabian Sea.
 
• The region also supports industries like shipbuilding and tourism.
